LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which things can you see and touch in the classroom?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify concrete and abstract nouns from a text
2. use concrete and abstract nouns correctly in a variety of contexts
3. appreciate the role of concrete and abstract nouns in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes for Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify concrete and abstract nouns from a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use concrete and abstract nouns correctly in a variety of contexts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of concrete and abstract nouns in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which things can you see and touch in the classroom?
2. Which things cannot be seen or touched?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify concrete and abstract nouns from a text
2. use concrete and abstract nouns correctly in a variety of contexts
3. appreciate the role of concrete and abstract nouns in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
